components.name: ResultsList
components.caption: Results — cards in the shell
components.readme:
# ResultsList — result cards (v3.2)

The search result page, rendered inside the AppShell at 1440 so it reads as a screen. One `canvas`, one white `surface` panel with a `line` border, cards separated by `line-subtle` hairlines. Every value is production (18 Sep 2026): the query "Knitted shirts · GOTS valid" returns 320 suppliers (HS 6105 exporters holding a valid GOTS).

**Panel header:** select-all · query as `title` · live count in `caption` · Sort (default: most sources) · Save search · Export CSV · card / table toggle (`seg`). **Footer:** "1–25 of 320", per-page, Prev / Next.

**Card, top to bottom — the reference's anatomy, kept band for band:**

1. **Identity.** 48px logo slot (initials on the top source's `tier` mark; a real logo replaces it), name in `title` that wraps at any length (the 101-character Zaheen name is the sample), the **source-mark row** where the reference has "Verified" (20px rank squares, `eyebrow` code, count), then the meta line at 14px — type · district · est. · workers — each fact followed by a 16px mark of the register it came from. Actions top-right: Save · Open record · Send RFQ (`brand`, disabled on a sanctioned record).
2. **Highlight chips.** Facts that answer the search, in status hues only: `positive-tint` for valid / active, `caution-tint` for expiring, expired, behind schedule or no longer covered, outline `neu` for neutral facts (EPB exporter · N lines, Listed by), dashed `quiet` for nothing on file. Never brand, never a score. "+N more" opens the Highlights popover.
3. **Four tiles + photo strip.** Tiles (2×2, ≥172px wide, `line-subtle` hairline, no fill): Certificates · Export lines · Listed by · Registers, each label (13px `ink-muted`) · value (15px 500, never wraps) · a link into the sheet tab. A missing value is `—` in `quiet-ink` with the reason beneath ("none on 4 registers"). The strip holds 132px photo tiles keyed by EPB HS code — caption `HS 6105` in mono + a short heading that fits without clamping — a "+N ›" pill at the right edge, and the note "Photos illustrative, keyed to the HS code". A record with no export lines shows one dashed `quiet` slot naming the register checked.

**Which photos, in which order.** Photos are a catalogue keyed to the 4-digit HS heading (`design/assets/products/hs/manifest.json`: the 46 headings with 20+ exporters), shared by every supplier who exports that line until the supplier uploads their own (V2). So that neighbouring cards do not all lead with the same navy polo, a supplier's strip shows its **least-common lines first** (by exporter count on EPB) — Aboni leads with socks and jumpsuits, a hat exporter with hats. A heading without a photo keeps its place and shows the code on the `surface-sunken` ground with "no photo yet"; nothing is substituted.
4. **Why matched (V2 only).** One line in `smart`, tagged `V2`, naming the filters met — never a number.

**States.** Selected: filled checkbox + 3px `brand` inset rule (the card stays white). Sanctioned: 4px `sanction` bar, a one-line `sanction-ink` notice under the meta, the Sanctioned badge first in the chip row, Send RFQ disabled — nothing in the layout can hide it (Zaheen is a labelled sample; not sanctioned in production). Nothing on file: quiet, never a warning (A.R. Fashion).

Rhythm: 14px body, 13px labels, `space-4` between bands, `space-3` inside a band, `space-5` card padding. Photos are inlined as data URIs when rendering PNGs; the published preview keeps the manifest's CDN URL with `onerror` hiding a failed image so the slot still looks intentional.

components.name: ResultsTable
components.caption: Results — table view in the shell
components.readme:
# ResultsTable — the toggle's other state

Same panel header and footer as ResultsList, with the table toggle on. `row-dense` 36px rows in `table` text; a long name wraps and grows its row rather than truncating. Header on `surface-sunken` in `eyebrow` mono.

Columns: **Supplier** (24px initials tile on the top source's tier, name in 500, place in `ink-muted`) · **Sources** (count in mono `figure` + the first four rank marks + "+N") · **Certificates** (two 22px status chips + "+N": `GOTS valid`, `WRAP 11 d`, `WRAP expired`, `GOTS 44 d` — the number is days to expiry when inside 90) · **Export lines** (the supplier's three least-common lines as 28px HS-keyed thumbs + "+N"; a heading without a photo shows its code on the sunken ground) · **Type** · **Workers** (right-aligned, tabular) · Save and Send RFQ.

Rows are the real top eight for the query, sorted by most sources, plus the two state samples: the sanctioned row carries the 4px `sanction` inset and a `sanction-ink` line under the name with Send RFQ disabled; the nothing-on-file row says why each cell is empty. Selected is the filled checkbox and a 3px `brand` inset — no tinted row. No match column in V1.

components.name: SupplierSheet
components.caption: Supplier record — sheet over the results
components.readme:
# SupplierSheet — the record over the results

Opens from Open record or the name, as an 880px `surface` sheet with a `line` left rule and `shadow-lg` over a 32% `surface-inverse` scrim; the results keep their scroll and selection behind it.

**Bar** (52px): close · "Supplier record" · read date, source count and "pages unchanged since read" · Share · more. **Head:** 48px logo, name in `heading-lg` (wraps), the meta line with a mark per fact plus the BGMEA number in `code`, then the full source-mark row with the source names spelled out. **Tabs** with counts in mono: Overview · Products 12 · Certificates 4 · Safety RSC · Sources 11 · Locations 1 · Facilities · RFQs 0. Tabs scroll to sections; the active one has a 2px `brand` underline.

**Overview** is two columns: a plain-language summary made only of facts, then the **FactsPanel** — 28px rows, label 150px in `ink-muted`, value in `ink`, and the mark of the register each fact came from at the right; "Not on file" in `quiet-ink` with what was checked. Beside it the **contact card, locked by default**: a striped `locked` / `locked-stripe` top that says exactly what is hidden (1 email · 6 phones · website · 2 named representatives, from which registers) and a white foot that says the RFQ still reaches the supplier. Never a blur.

**Products:** four `stat` blocks (HS lines · Product list · Certified scope · Buyer lists, each with its source) and a six-up grid of HS-keyed photo tiles, "All 12 lines ›", and the illustrative note. **Certificates:** one card per certificate with the issuer's rank mark, scheme, state badge (valid / expiring with days left / no expiry on file / expired), number in `code`, issuer and scope in `caption`, link to the issuer's page. **Safety:** RSC remediation on a 6px `positive` meter with status words, and the five report links (a missing one is a dashed quiet chip).

**Action bar**, sticky on `surface-glass`: Send RFQ (`brand`, `control-lg`) · Save to list · Compare · "Every fact links to its source page". A sanctioned record adds the sanction banner under the bar on every tab and disables Send RFQ.

components.name: ProductSheet
components.caption: Product line — nested sheet with back
components.readme:
# ProductSheet — one HS export line

A nested sheet reached from a photo tile, with Back and a breadcrumb (supplier / `HS 6105`) in the bar. Left: the 320px illustrative photo with its caption (generated per HS heading, not the supplier's product; a supplier-attested upload replaces it in V2). Right: `eyebrow` "HS 6105 · EPB export line", the official heading in `heading`, then a FactsPanel — chapter, the EPB exporter page with read date, exporting since (not on file: EPB lists lines, not dates), other lines in `code`, certified scope with its state badge, the BGMEA product list, buyer lists, and price · MOQ · lead time (supplier-attested, shown only when attested) — each with its source mark. Actions: Send RFQ for this line (`brand`) and "Other exporters of 6105 · 1,635", which runs the code across the catalogue with its live count.

components.name: RFQComposer
components.caption: RFQ composer — rail, editor with variables, preview
components.readme:
# RFQComposer — request for quote

A 1180px dialog (`radius-lg`, `shadow-lg`) over the results. The reference's three columns, kept because each earns its width: a **rail** on `canvas` (Suppliers · Product · Details 2/6 · Questions 10 · Follow-up rules V2), each step with a count and a `caution-ink` line naming what is still missing; the **editor** with the template switch (First contact / Repeat supplier), Attach, Insert variable and the `smart` V2 "Improve wording", a subject and body with inline **variables** (`brand-tint` chips; a missing one is `caution-tint`), the product table (a missing target price reads "Missing" in `caution-ink`) and the question list with REQUIRED stamps; and the **preview** on `surface-sunken` that shows the message exactly as the supplier receives it, missing fields still flagged.

The message cites the record — certificate number, expiry, HS line — so the supplier knows the buyer read it. The footer counts what is missing; Send RFQ stays disabled until the required fields are filled; Save draft always works. The buyer's own email and phone are never shared, and the supplier's contact details are not needed on this side: SourceBD delivers.

components.name: RFQList
components.caption: RFQ list — status chips, table, toast
components.readme:
# RFQList — the RFQs page

Page heading with the live counts (7 sent · 0 quotes — production, 18 Sep 2026), search, Fields, Sort and + New RFQ (`brand`); a row of status chips with counts (All · Awaiting reply · Quoted · Reply overdue · Draft · Closed); a 36px-row table — RFQ name with the HS code in `code`, supplier with its tier tile, quantity (tabular, right-aligned), status badge (`positive` for sent / awaiting, `caution` for overdue, `typ` for draft with the number of fields still missing), sent and ship-by dates, action. The rows are the real production RFQs as stored, plus the draft from RFQComposer at the top.

The toast (`surface-inverse`, `signal` dot) confirms a draft save and names the supplier. At launch almost every buyer sees the EmptyState copy instead of this table: "Your first RFQ lands here. Suppliers answer inside the platform, with the record attached."
